part.text:
All 108 tests in the intervals package pass. The fix:

**`lucene/queries/src/java/org/apache/lucene/queries/intervals/IntervalBuilder.java`** — `NoIntervalsIterator` now tracks its position with a `doc` field initialized to `-1` (unpositioned), and `nextDoc()`/`advance()` set it to `NO_MORE_DOCS` (IntervalBuilder.java:289, 349-362). Previously `docID()` unconditionally returned `NO_MORE_DOCS`, which broke the DocIdSetIterator contract for unpositioned iterators and caused exceptions when an all-stopword (empty) interval query was combined in a conjunction.

Verification: `./gradlew :lucene:queries:test --tests "org.apache.lucene.queries.intervals.*"` → SUCCESS (108 tests, 0 failed), including `TestIntervalBuilder.testEmptyIntervals` which asserts `docID() == -1` before advancing. (Note: I had to generate the missing `gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar` locally to make `./gradlew` runnable, since GitHub is unreachable from the test container; no test files were modified.)
